summary: Iteration 44 — Backend-only tests for In-app Notifications. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter44_notifications.py with 24 tests covering all 5 REST endpoints, 9 auto-trigger flows, auth enforcement, cross-user isolation, and payload contents. Result: 24/24 PASSED. All notification triggers fire correctly, `unread_only` filter works, `mark-read all=true` is scoped to the current user, DELETE {id} of another user's notif returns 404, and the `data` payload contains the expected contextual IDs (job_id, application_id, worker_id, escrow_id, complaint_id, leave_id, etc.). One minor dead-code smell noted (unreachable duplicate block right after admin_reject_complaint at server.py:2671-2674) — not a functional bug.

notify_admins() caps at 50 admins via to_list(length=50); acceptable for current scale.

All 9 trigger points confirmed live: application_new, application_accepted/rejected, attendance_check_in/check_out, complaint_new (fan-out to admins), complaint_resolved/rejected, wallet_credit (escrow release), leave_request, leave_approved/rejected, profile_verified, account_suspended, account_unsuspended.
Notifications correctly exclude Mongo `_id` via projection.
List endpoint clamps limit between 1..200 — safe against abuse.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ jobs / applications / complaints / leaves / escrow via the API using the seeded demo accounts. Each test class clears its own user's notifications before running. teardown_module also clears all four demo accounts' notification inboxes at the end. No lingering test data in notifications collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter44_notifications.py can be re-run standalone: `pytest backend/tests/test_iter44_notifications.py -v`. It logs in with the seeded demo accounts (WORKER 9000000002, CLIENT 9000000001, CONTRACTOR 9000000003, ADMIN 9000000000). It uses a module-scoped autouse fixture to clear notifications first, and cross-test coupling exists via `pytest._notif_job` (job used across application + attendance + escrow + leave tests). Do not reorder classes without adjusting that. All 9 auto-trigger flows are exercised end-to-end and payload data fields are asserted.
